text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills rose to 57.25 percent from 53.92 percent at the last sale, a Ukrainian central bank official said on Thursday.
Results of Wednesday's auction, compared to the last issue
of three-month T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 15.701 million UAH 5.432 million UAH
Actual amount raised 13.740 million UAH 4.789 million UAH
Ukraine's central bank sold 157,011 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 106,274 were competitive and 50,737 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of discount three-month T-bills has not been announced.
Average yields at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills rose to 59.50 percent from 56.66 percent at the last auction, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 10,162 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 9,782 were competitive and 434 were non-competitive.
The next auction of six-month discount T-bills has not been announced.
The sale of nine- and 12-month T-bills scheduled for September 19 were cancelled without explanation, and a date for the next auctions has not been announced. --Kiev newsroom, +380 44 229-2264
